_note: RESERVED set of the RAG (15 Nov 2026), written BEFORE the improvements of phase 1 of the retrieval plan. FROZEN: it is not used to tune the search or the thresholds; only to measure whether what was tuned with the other sets generalizes. Fifteen topics that do not appear in the other sets, plus four out-of-scope questions (some close to the topic). The Spanish versions of these questions were removed when the RAG became English-only, so earlier figures measured on this set no longer apply. Each anchor was looked up in the text extracted from the PDFs, and a test checks that it still exists in the real index. Usage: python -m spaceapp.modules.knowledge.evaluate --questions data/knowledge/eval_questions_reserved.json --diagnose
